description: Natural Hazards: from a place or bounded area and window to the hazard events authorities published (earthquakes with magnitude and location revisions, tropical cyclone advisories as issued, flood and wildfire alerts), each with source, revision and as-of time. Parameters are quoted from the issuing body; revisions are kept, never overwritten.

vocabulary.estimate: the publisher's impact estimate with product version
vocabulary.none on record: a covered source published nothing; never 'safe'

optional_features.description: Link hazard events to climate-environment records that publish the same identifier; a selection of this feature, so disabling Climate and Environment never depends on Natural Hazards

requires.reason: climate-environment records linked by citation or shared identifier

optional_features.description: Link hazard events to weather warnings by citation once the Weather bundle (#2163) provides them; reported unavailable (omitted) while no provider declares the capability

requires.reason: weather warnings cited by or citing a hazard record

optional_features.description: GloFAS flood notifications behind the NH01 access decision: registered access (NOESIS_GLOFAS_TOKEN), modelled output quoted with version and issue time, no layer mirroring

requires.reason: the key-gated glofas-notifications source of the natural-hazards source pack

exclusions: hazard prediction or forecasting by Noesis
damage or loss estimates beyond quoting the publisher
attribution of events to climate change or other causes
mirroring of GloFAS or EFFIS raster layers
never: estimate damage beyond quoting the publisher
advise on safety, evacuation or protective action
merge or average two publishers' parameters
attribute an event to a cause

query_examples.intent: Which hazard events affected this place as of a date
query_examples.semantics: revision in force at as-of with full revision history; none on record vs source not covered
